title: bubbleD rejected by App Review, appeal filed
detail: Submitted 2 Nov. Spent eight days assuming it was going through. The red indicator in App Store Connect turned out to be a rejection, not a pending state, so the decision is now under appeal. The edsa.tech card still reads 'in App Store review'.

title: usenope.com is live
detail: Nope's landing page moved to its own domain, usenope.com: static HTML and CSS on Cloudflare, with a Content-Security-Policy that blocks loading anything from other sites, same as the extension's no-network promise.

title: One devlog behind every session, the tweets and the public changelog
detail: Every Claude Code session on this machine now writes milestones to a single append-only log. The same log feeds the X post drafts and the public changelog at edsa.tech/log/, so what gets announced and what gets recorded can't drift apart.

title: An $80 charge from a free trial I forgot to cancel
detail: Zeely, an AI ad and video tool, charged about $80 on the Growth plan. Chose not to chase a refund and to spend every credit marketing Nope instead, posting the numbers every Sunday. Nope is free, so the $80 only comes back through Pro — about 5 sales at $19.99 under Apple's Small Business Program.

title: Two months of daily video across five platforms
detail: Posted a video every day for two months on Facebook, TikTok, YouTube, Instagram and Threads. Facebook ~250 followers, TikTok ~250, the other three under 10 each. Best reels hit 1K-3K likes. App sales from it: basically zero.

title: Deleted the on-device AI model from Gaby
detail: Earlier versions downloaded a ~1.8 GB Hugging Face model on first launch. It invented wrong Spanish and froze a 3GB-RAM iPad during onboarding. Every Spanish sentence and every correction is now written by a person and fixed at release.

title: edsa.tech rebuilt as a three-app store grid
detail: The home page is now the three apps side by side, each with icon, real screenshots and a Get button, sized so all three fit one 1440x900 screen. The old microservices marketing is gone; the blog is a quiet list at the bottom.

title: bubbleD submitted for App Store review
detail: A Pomodoro timer that writes the timesheet for you. Built over the Halloween weekend. Lives at bubbled.me; edsa.tech carries a card for it.

title: Nope approved on the App Store
detail: Approved on Halloween US time. Safari on iPhone, iPad and Mac. Free, no account, and the build check fails if any extension file contains fetch(, XMLHttpRequest, WebSocket(, sendBeacon( or eval(.

title: Nope live on the Chrome Web Store
detail: First store listing for Nope. Free, and it makes no network requests at all.

title: Gaby went free with a one-time $14.99 unlock
detail: Changed from paid-upfront to a free download with a single $14.99 in-app purchase. No subscription. Every pricing line across the site and the quiz pages had to be corrected in the same pass.
